summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes opaque obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style renamed (_0xNNNNNN identifiers, per-function string-indirection maps) and at install time downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle with a numeric opcode table, string-array decoder, and hex-renamed identifiers, whose behavior is unrelated to the package's stated purpose (a Vue 'copyable text' component). math_init.js also ships in the tarball root despite package.json declaring files: ['lib/*'], so its inclusion is outside the declared file allowlist. Installing the package causes arbitrary code — whatever bytes ship in math_init.js — to execute on the installer's machine under a freshly downloaded Bun binary.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
